title: researcher.visited
description: A researcher visit began. Written at the START of the visit; every decision of the visit (direction, lessons.published, question.asked) has this event's id as its `cause`, and its own `cause` is the human.instructed that triggered it, if any. Subject is bench:<name>.

trigger.description: Why the visit ran: the schedule fired, or a human instruction was waiting.

digest.description: Blob digest of the digest JSON the researcher was shown, so the decision can be audited against exactly what it saw.

model.description: Model that made the decisions, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5'.
